description: This PHP source file defines the CustomerAPI class within the OrangeHRM Time plugin, providing RESTful API endpoints for managing Customer entities. It includes methods for listing, creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting customers, with validation rules and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: CustomerAPI
classes.description: A RESTful API endpoint class for managing Customer entities, including listing, retrieving, creating, updating, and deleting customers with validation and documentation annotations.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all customers, supports filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete customers by IDs.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a single customer by ID.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the create method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getOne method.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update method.

methods.name: getCommonBodyValidationRules
methods.description: Helper method to generate common validation rules for request bodies.

methods.name: getNameCommonUniqueOption
methods.description: Creates and returns an EntityUniquePropertyOption with ignore conditions for uniqueness validation.

methods.name: setParamsToCustomer
methods.description: Sets customer properties from request parameters.
